blocks.text: Yhtpouqe Durable Tall Plant Stakes are Essential Garden Accessories to Train your Climbing Plants to Grow Upwards.

High-quality Material: Crafted with durable and plant-friendly material.
The indoor plant stakes for potted plants are odorless and do not fade or rust with long-term use. Detachable and Practical: Simply Insert plant support stake into the soil and can be used separately or freely assembled.
The garden stakes for gardening easy installation and detach without any garden tools.

Multi-functional: Sturdy enough to Keep plants from bending and support low-hanging branches. Also withstands varying weather conditions.
 ensuring long-lasting durability.
Adjustable Length Design: Adjusting the height as your alternative to traditional tomato trellis, stem holders and indoor plant trellis. Package Including
12 Pack 39.37 inch plant support stakes
12 PCS plant clips
One roll of 6.56 ft garden ties

items.label: Detachable Plant Support
items.value: plant support stakes provide reliable support for indoor and outdoor plants. The plant stakes are ingeniously designed to be stackable and can be adjusted in height to accommodate the growth of climbing plants.

items.label: Perfectly Blend with Plants
items.value: The green plant stakes for indoor plants easily integrate with your monstera plants and remain unnoticed, ensuring your houseplants grow healthily and upright. Our plant supports also the best alternative to metal rings, moss poles and bamboo stakes.

items.label: Durable and Plant- friendly Plastic
items.value: Compared with traditional plant poles. The plant support sticks are made of high-quality plastic which will not fade. Also protecting plant roots from rotting. The plant sticks support tall plants and strong enough to holding up low hanging branches.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: Comes with 3 sections that can be used separately or freely assembled for potted plants. Easy installation and detach without any garden tools. These indoor plant stakes suitable for small, medium-sized and large plants. So you can keep adding as plant grows with the multiple extension poles.

items.label: What You Get
items.value: The plant accessories contain 12 pack 39.37 inch plant stakes for outdoor plants, 12pcs plant clips, and 6.56ft garden ties. Perfect for monstera, Pothos, Orchid, Morning Glory, rose, vines, Hoya, Begonia and flower arrangements.
